CANDIDATE: Existing external supervisor observing a dedicated kernel workload boundary, with monotonic deadline and kill/wait plus empty-boundary verification
EVIDENCE: Creation identity, membership, monotonic deadline, signals, observed exit and remaining membership, first failure, unknown outcome, final audit
EXISTING_FACILITIES: system manager/cgroup interfaces; timeout binary; wait/process observation APIs observed only
GAP: No exact external observer argv, resource allocation and independently supported permission/whole-boundary termination evidence
OWNER: Separately designated qualified controller; no existing qualified identity invented
PARENT_FAILURE: Guard must survive workload-parent failure and verify all exits; its own failure yields unknown, never success
PREFERRED_BOUNDARY: Dedicated cgroup if permission and lifecycle independently qualified. PID namespace may be an alternative after init/teardown coverage qualification. No required dependency on future Package86 pids result.
PROCESS_COVERAGE: Must include independent sessions and descendants; no process-group-only assurance
